newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Fed manufacturing index unchanged in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Fed manufacturing index unchanged in Nov.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago said its Chicago Fed Midwest Manufacturing Index (CFMMI) was unchanged at 129.5 in November after a revised 0.3 percent decline in October.
"The Midwest manufacturing sector significantly underperformed the nation during November after closely tracking the nation during September and October," the bank's report said.

Machinery manufacturing, off 1.0 percent from the prior month, was the "biggest pocket of weakness" in November, it said. In addition, steel and auto production held down the region's output as well, suggesting the General Motors strike continued to hurt manufacturing, it said.

Of the CFMMI individual components, only the resource index rose, to 124.3 in November from 122.9 in October. The auto index dipped to 135.1 from 135.2, steel fell to 129.2 from 129.4 and machinery declined to 142.0 from 143.5.
